speaker: PATIENT
text: I've really been struggling with staying focused at work. Every time I try to start a task, my mind jumps to something else and I end up wasting hours.

speaker: THERAPIST
text: That sounds frustrating. Have you noticed if there's a particular time of day or situation when it happens more often?

speaker: PATIENT
text: Usually mid-afternoon, after lunch. I feel tired and then suddenly I'm thinking about groceries or some argument I had last week. I can't seem to pull myself back.

speaker: THERAPIST
text: It could be both physical fatigue and mental distraction. Have you tried any strategies to refocus, like short breaks or a checklist?

speaker: PATIENT
text: I've tried lists, but then I forget to look at them. Sometimes I set a timer for 25 minutes of work and 5 minutes off, like a Pomodoro thing, and it helps a little.
